verdicts.why: Hernandez never meets Rawlins alive; he pushes the CIA to give Rawlins up and later sees his corpse, so it sits between knowing about an investigation target and the huge-consequences exception.
A blood tie never met: T'Chaka dies years before Toussaint is born.
Valentina was presumably CIA director while Ross was president, which suggests they dealt with each other, but nothing on screen shows them together and her speech to Congress only cites him.
Shared battle where the two never deal with each other: Wong fights Mordo's cult and guards the portal, but Dormammu only deals with Spider-Man, Strange and Mary Jane.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#58
value.text: The Doomsday Device turns Kragov into Electro, and he injures the Kingpin, who ends up in the hospital.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Traps Fisk as the Red Skull, then injures him as Electro.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A crime lord he traps, then injures as Electro.

verdicts.why: They fight directly over the Doomsday Device, and in #58 Electro injures the Kingpin; the old text never showed the two dealing with each other, so it is rewritten. Only stage 1 is given since stage 0 is still there.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#45
value.text: With Mary Jane lost, May moves in with her Aunt Anna to help her through the loss.
value.on_a_card_about_b: May's friend Anna's niece. May grieves her loss with Anna.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's aunt, who moves in with Anna after Mary Jane is lost.

verdicts.why: The tie already stands, and in #45 May does move in with Anna to help her cope with losing Mary Jane; the text is rewritten because Mary Jane is gone in that episode, so May cannot keep setting her up with Peter. Only stage 1 is given since stage 0 is still there.
A name in someone's phone contacts shown on screen counts, by the owner's own rule; Jimmy Woo is listed among May's phone contacts.

Family who have met and a shared inner circle: both are Thanos's adopted children raised to serve him, and Gamora dislikes the Black Order.
Zola hints that Hydra arranged the crash that killed Maria, which would fit the huge-consequences exception, but his own part is only implied and never shown.
They deal with each other on screen: Joaquin is with Sam when Sam meets Dunphy at the Norfolk SEAL facility, and Joaquin works there on the mind-control intel.
A name in someone's phone contacts shown on screen counts; Natasha Romanoff is listed among May's phone contacts.
Selby's line that Zemo cannot find Nagel without her implies she knows him, and both work for the Power Broker, so they share an inner circle; each wiki page lists the other as an ally.

Classmates count: teenage Sitwell and Strucker are both at the Hydra Preparatory Academy alongside Hale in the flashbacks.
